objective: Select the fastest correct end-to-end strategy and retain enough evidence to falsify every native Cellerator preference.
fairness_rules: Run correctness before timing and exclude any candidate with semantic, order, shape, capacity, numeric, determinism, or residency mismatch.
Use the same immutable support, value generation, dense input, output semantics, requested order, numeric policy, stream policy, and reuse horizon for every candidate.
Charge each candidate for every conversion, preparation, allocation, synchronization, communication, and order transform it requires.
Amortize semantic packing, projection construction, and preparation only by their declared measured reuse counts.
Never infer a full-workflow winner from kernel-only timing.
Keep source-derived support and values distinct; structure-only traces may not make quantitative biological claims.
Report conventional fallbacks even when a native candidate is preferred.

phases.calculation: wall time from first required preparation or launch binding through final required consumer-visible completion

amortization.semantic_packing: divide only by measured structure reuse R_s
amortization.projection_construction: divide only by measured projection reuse R_p
amortization.backend_prepare: divide only by measured prepared-plan reuse R_p
amortization.persistent: report raw cost, declared reuse, amortized cost, and measured break-even reuse

required_metrics.source: Nsight Systems or explicit launch accounting

baseline_catalog.required_when: CPK1 native row-masked projection is compatible
CSR construction or persisted CSR is legal
logical and padded capacities are proven safe
baseline_catalog.current_evidence: tests/math_bell_lowering_test.cc plus historical CP-MATH-07 gate artifacts
baseline_catalog.activation_gate: new operation-core vendor candidate with capacity-safe bindings

baseline_catalog.required_when: an operation-core vendor capability accepts the exact request
baseline_catalog.current_evidence: native and vendor candidates share the operation-core registry; retired CP-Math descriptors remain historical evidence

baseline_catalog.required_when: density and conversion cost make dense execution plausible

falsification_rules: Prefer a conventional candidate whenever its measured end-to-end median is faster than the native candidate by more than the recorded practical tolerance.
Reject semantic geometry or projection construction whose measured preparation cost cannot break even within the declared reuse horizon.
Reject persistent execution order when its saved transforms do not repay dynamic input packing or downstream incompatibility.
Reject a dense fragment when projection, padding, and dense compute exceed the best sparse candidate end to end.
Reject materialization when a correct fused Baseplane path wins over the complete reuse horizon; reject fusion when reusable materialization wins.
Treat a profiler-only theoretical advantage as insufficient without correctness and wall-clock evidence.
Record a no-winner result when variance or contamination exceeds the resource contract rather than selecting by noise.
stop_conditions: Any correctness, identity, order, capacity, canary, sanitizer, or determinism failure stops performance stages for that candidate.
GPU memory headroom below the tier minimum stops the run before allocation.
Overlapping benchmark, profiler, or host-pressure ownership stops measured timing.
Missing source checksum, trace checksum, build identity, or command provenance invalidates the result.
Unsupported numeric policy or architecture capability is a structured rejection, not a failed benchmark.
Three contaminated or high-variance attempts produce an inconclusive result and no planner winner.
